verdict.rationale: Runpod explicitly documents CLI and REST API support to create, start, stop, and terminate Pods (runpod-docs-46, runpod-docs-29, runpod-docs-8, runpod-docs-26), and billing is per-second with no charges when stopped/scaled to zero (runpod-docs-50, runpod-docs-20, runpod-docs-25). Network volumes preserve data independent of running compute so terminating doesn't lose state (runpod-docs-18, runpod-docs-54). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of programmatic lifecycle control (community evidence only covers availability/setup, not start/stop/terminate via API) and clearer documentation of a distinct 'restart' API call.
